landing.title: A quiet moment to check in with yourself.
landing.lead: Answer a few short, clinically validated questions about how you've been feeling over the last two weeks, and get a clear, plain-language summary.
landing.p1Body: GAD-7, PHQ-9 and OASIS, scored with their official rules.
landing.p2Body: Your answers are encrypted. Guests leave no trace after 24 hours.
landing.p3Body: One question at a time. You can stop whenever you like.

about.title: About Calma
about.p1: Calma helps you notice how you've been feeling, using questionnaires that doctors and researchers use worldwide: GAD-2 and GAD-7 for anxiety, PHQ-9 for depression, and OASIS for how anxiety affects daily life.
about.p2: Your answers are scored with each questionnaire's official, validated rules. That score is always the main result. An AI-assisted estimate is shown next to it as extra context, with the factors that influenced it most.
about.p3: Calma can't diagnose anything. If your results worry you, or if you're struggling, please talk to a doctor, counsellor or someone you trust.
about.privacy: Answers and anything you write are encrypted. If you don't create an account, your check-in is deleted after 24 hours. With an account you can download or delete all your data at any time. There are no analytics trackers on assessment pages.

consent.title: Before you begin
consent.c1: This is a screening check, not a diagnosis or medical advice.
consent.c2: You'll answer standard questions about the last two weeks. Answer as honestly as you can; there are no right or wrong answers.
consent.c3: Your answers are encrypted. As a guest, they're deleted after 24 hours.
consent.c4: If an answer suggests you might be at risk, we'll show you where to get support straight away. You'll still see your results.
consent.agree: I understand and want to continue

assess.title: Check-in
assess.keysHint: Tip: press {first}–{last} on your keyboard to answer.
assess.saveFailed: Couldn't save. We'll retry when you answer the next question.
assess.contextLead: This helps put your results in context. Only age group is needed.
assess.lowTitle: Low likelihood of an anxiety disorder
assess.lowBody: Your answers to the first two questions suggest a low likelihood of an anxiety disorder. You can see your result now, or continue with a fuller check if you'd like.
assess.lifestyleLead: These can help the AI-assisted estimate. Skip any you like.
assess.sleep: On average, how many hours do you sleep a night?
assess.duration: How long have you been feeling this way?
assess.caffeine: Cups of coffee, tea or energy drinks a day
assess.stress: Has something very stressful happened recently?
assess.freeTitle: Anything else you'd like to share?
assess.freeLead: Optional. This is encrypted and only used to make sure you get support if you need it.
assess.englishOnly: These questions are shown in English until an official validated Hindi version is added.

crisis.title: You don't have to go through this alone.
crisis.body: Some of your answers suggest you may be going through a really hard time. Talking to someone can help, and support is available right now, free and confidential.

results.title: Your results

gad7.0: Your answers suggest minimal anxiety symptoms.
gad7.1: Your answers suggest mild anxiety symptoms. Keeping an eye on how you feel can help.
gad7.2: Your answers suggest moderate anxiety symptoms. It may help to talk to a health professional.
gad7.3: Your answers suggest severe anxiety symptoms. Please consider talking to a health professional soon.

gad2.0: Your answers suggest a low likelihood of an anxiety disorder.
gad2.1: Your answers suggest a fuller check would be helpful.

results.aiBody: An extra view from a statistical model, shown with its confidence. The validated score above always comes first.
results.aiAgree: This matches your validated GAD-7 band.
results.aiDisagree: This differs from your validated GAD-7 band. The validated score takes priority.
results.aiSynthetic: Prototype model trained on simulated data. Not clinically validated.
results.aiNone: The AI-assisted estimate needs the full check (GAD-7, PHQ-9 and OASIS).
results.quality: Some answers looked unusual ({flags}). If you rushed, you might like to take the check again.
results.n1: Share these results with a doctor, counsellor or someone you trust.
results.n2: If your score is moderate or higher, consider booking an appointment soon.
results.n3: Checking in again in 2–4 weeks can show you how things are changing.
results.save: Create an account to save this result
results.saveBody: Guest results are deleted after 24 hours.
results.shareCode: Give this code to your clinician: {code}. It expires on {date}.
results.notFound: We couldn't find this result. Guest results are only available in the browser tab where you took the check, for 24 hours.
